title: PNP: Quezon City Task Force Disiplina members not authorized to carry guns on duty

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) clarified Tuesday that membership in Quezon City's Task Force Disiplina does not authorize its personnel to carry firearms while on duty, following the fatal shooting of three teenagers in Barangay Batasan Hills.
